use_scope: Research-only forward first-seen snapshots. The timestamp when the collector actually fetched data is available-time evidence; it is not proof of an earlier publisher posting time.

taiex.forward_rule: Fetch after Taiwan 20:00 and require exact cash-market trading date and raw response hash

margin.forward_rule: Fetch after Taiwan 20:00, require response date equals current trading session

cash_inst.forward_rule: Fetch after Taiwan 20:00, require response date equals current trading session

tx_oi.forward_rule: Fetch after Taiwan 20:00, check requested date, official TXF contract and foreign-investor OI arithmetic

fx.official_schedule: Normally Mondays 16:15 Eastern, prior business week; holiday shifts to next business day
fx.forward_rule: Capture first-seen returned observation and fetch time; never assign earlier time

us10y.forward_rule: Actual first-seen time only; historical source clock requires independent review

nfci.official_schedule: Wednesday 08:30 Eastern for period through previous Friday; Thursday in affected holiday weeks

hy.provider: ICE Data Indices LLC through FRED
hy.forward_rule: FRED first-seen UTC fetch timestamp stored; no inferred vendor release minute

ig.provider: ICE Data Indices LLC through FRED
ig.forward_rule: FRED first-seen UTC fetch timestamp stored; no inferred vendor release minute; not a 6-factor feature

vix.forward_rule: FRED first-seen UTC fetch timestamp stored; source vendor exact release minute not certified
